thread:
Avery (CEO): Thanks for the great Q&A earlier. Requested we capture concrete patterns on customer wins vs losses and the top asks we should funnel into the roadmap. I'll start with a quick synthesis, then open to clarifying Qs.

Maya (Sales): Field summary: wins when we show predictable latency and simple pricing math. Losses when customers cite gaps in SSO/KMS, SOC2 artifacts, or that our private deployment options are unclear. Also a recurring ask for dedicated capacity SLAs for steady-state inference.

Priya (CS): From post-sale: wins correlate with fast POC success + Redwood Optimize suggestions. Losses post-POC usually trace to poor handoff docs, missing runbooks for SREs, and lack of sample dashboards.

Sam (Product): Top product asks we should prioritize: BYOK/KMS, enterprise audit logs, sample onboarding checklist, and SOC2 artifact pack for sales. We'll draft a roadmap note after this thread.

Leo (SE): Technical point: customers want model-version pinning and deterministic evals. Small SE snippets reduce friction in proofs-of-concept. Example we put in demos:
```yaml
model_pin: redwood-v2.1
rollout: canary(10%)
```

Jon (Eng): Engineering: stability issues driving losses are usually long-tail latency under bursty batching. We're introducing KV-cache miss metrics and per-request trace ids to help correlate.

Maya (Sales): FYI: a few large deals paused specifically for BYOK details. Any ETA?

Avery (CEO): BYOK/KMS is prioritized on the Dedicated/Private track. Targeting a Q3 beta. @Sam please own a one-pager sales can use in the interim with legal/KMS talking points.

Sam (Product): Will do. Draft in #product-resources by EOD tomorrow, with suggested contract language and a short diagram for sales.

Priya (CS): Can docs include an "ops checklist" and sample alerting thresholds? That lowers time-to-value.

Leo (SE): I'll add a 6-step POC checklist and runnable snips to the SE kit.

Jon (Eng): For oncall: we're shipping request.trace_id and KV-cache metrics. If you paste a trace id in #eng-oncall we'll pull flamegraphs.

Avery (CEO): Two asks for leadership: 1) allocate a small docs/SE collateral sprint next month, 2) make SOC2 artifacts + a public FAQ a priority for sales enablement. I'll take to finance.

All-Hands Bot: Notes and action items -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1773620011

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This should shorten ramp.

Priya (CS): Can someone surface a prioritized list of lost deals by reason for Q1? That helped focus work last cycle.

Sam (Product): I'll pull that report with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks everyone. Drop customer snippets and call notes on the Notion page. Closing thread.
